newsitem.title: UK: UK shares start lower after Dow's weak finish.
newsitem.headline: UK shares start lower after Dow's weak finish.

text.p: UK share prices fell on Tuesday and the leading index was seen testing support around the 4,000 level after losses in the U.S. depressed sentiment.
The FTSE 100 index had lost 20.8 points at 4,004.5 by 0840 GMT. All but a handful of stocks were marked lower.
"We are looking at a 60-point reversal in the U.S. from where we left it last night and despite the bid yesterday London wasn't very happy about itself," said one senior trader.
The Dow was up 26 points as London markets closed on Monday but finished 35-points lower as investors braced themselves for an onslaught of economic news this week.
